info.title: csdg
info.description: A tool for creating code dependency graphs, exporting and visualizing

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Sets the verbosity level of the command. Allowed values are: q[uiet], m[inimal], n[ormal], d[etailed], diag[nostic]. [default: Normal]

options.name: --property
options.description: Defines one or more MSBuild properties. Specify multiple properties delimited by semicolons or by repeating the option: -p prop1=val1;prop2=val2 or -p prop1=val1 -p prop2=val2.

options.name: --parse-generated
options.description: Parse the generated code not located in intermediate output path

options.name: --links-to-self
options.description: Include references to symbols from your own type

options.name: --links-to-primitives
options.description: Include links to symbols of primitive types

options.name: --split-asm-versions
options.description: Create separate nodes for each version of an assembly

options.name: --output
options.description: The file name where the export should be written

options.name: --hide-external
options.description: When enabled all external nodes with root hides

options.name: --export-level
options.description: Defines the level below which all nodes are excluded. Allowed values are: assembly, namespace, type, public-member, all. [default: All]

options.name: --node-filter
options.description: Defines one or more node filter. Glob pattern is applied on the node path. The filter action can be 'hide', 'dissolve' or 'skip'. When a node is hidden, it is deleted along with all its connections. When a node dissolves, the node is hidden and its links are linked to its parent. When a node is skipped, the node remains as is. All filters are applied to the node one by one. When the filter is triggered, this chain is interrupted.
